verdict.rationale: Oneleet documents a versioned Public API (/api/v1/) with a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec covering 157 paths, a separate Auditor API spec, and Scalar-rendered interactive references. Access uses scoped service keys intended for scripts and AI agents. The probe 404s were on docs.oneleet.com paths and do not contradict the spec served at api.oneleet.com. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the API, and a published versioning/deprecation policy or changelog with a stated notice window.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Oneleet serves a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.3 document for its Public API (157 paths) at the API origin
Use service keys for AI agent automation, MCP servers, and scripts to interact with your Oneleet workspace.
